'''''Recovery''''' was a [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifter]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Lifter was used to pick up a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] ''[[Scarlet 4]]'' that a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] was ordered to disable.
